subject: Welcome bridge: temp keys, role mapping, and invite cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amalia Torres <amalia@novaworks.com>
Cc: Tom Lin <tom.lin@novaworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Welcome bridge: temp keys, role mapping, and invite cadence

Hi Amalia —

Welcome again and congrats on getting the contract across the finish line. I’m the Implementation Lead for the NovaWorks workspace and I’ll be coordinating the initial tenant setup and access handoff with you and Tom. Below is a short checklist to get us live in the staging tenant this week: 

1) Confirm list of admins who should receive permanent admin invites (Name + email + role: Admin/Owner/Viewer).
2) Use the attached temp-keys.csv to seed a short-lived API key for initial testing. These are one-time credentials; we’ll rotate them as part of the admin invite flow.
3) Fill the role-mapping template (attached) with your internal role names so we create matching RBAC groups.
4) Schedule a 30-min handoff call — I proposed a slot in the link below.

Attachments: [Attachment: welcome-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)], [Attachment: temp-keys.csv (CSV, 2 KB)], [Attachment: role-mapping-template.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)]

Next steps for us: Ben will share the recommended default RBAC groups and a short security note about service account handling; Monica will send the calendar invite and onboarding doc. Please reply with the admin list and any compliance questions.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks, Irene — this is great. Quick answers:

- I’ll be the primary admin during setup (Amalia Torres, amalia@novaworks.com).
- Tom will be our infra lead (tom.lin@novaworks.com) and needs Admin access too.
- We’d like a Developer role that maps to our internal "Platform Engineers" group and a ReadOnly role for analysts.

I have a procurement question before we exchange permanent credentials: can you confirm where keys are stored and whether Redwood can integrate with our AWS KMS for key escrow? Also please include any SOC2 evidence we can share with our internal security team.

I filled the role-mapping template and attached it here. I can join a call tomorrow afternoon; I accepted the tentative slot on the calendar.

Best,

Subject: Re: Welcome bridge: temp keys, role mapping, and invite cadence

Thanks Amalia — quick replies on the security pieces:

- Key storage: Redwood supports customer KMS integrations on Private and Dedicated plans. For Hosted, we store service keys encrypted and rotated; we can add an additional KMS wrap keyed to an HSM for customers with stricter controls.
- SOC2 evidence: I’m attaching the incremental items we typically share (security-overview.pdf and access-audit-sample.csv). For procurement we can provide an SSP and auditor contact under an NDA if required.
- Temp keys: those CSV entries in Irene's temp-keys.csv are TTL=72 hours by default. We recommend rotating to seeded service accounts once you confirm the admin set.

Recommendations for role mapping based on the file Amalia sent:
- Developer -> Platform Engineers (full api write except billing routes)
- Analyst -> ReadOnly (generate embeddings, read model outputs)
- Admin -> Owner (manage invites, billing visibility)

Irene / Monica — I can own the KMS bridging discussion if Novaworks wants to pursue.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
